This vertical editorial illustration features a medium close-up of a man from the chest up against a black background. He has short, slicked-back gray hair and tan skin. He wears a dark suit jacket over a white shirt and a blue-and-white diagonally striped tie. His expression is neutral with his mouth slightly open.

The large red word "TEMPO" is positioned behind his head. Above it, white text reads: "INVESTIGASI: KEJANGGALAN OPINI AUDIT DKI JAKARTA / SIAPA PENCURI KABEL BAWAH LAUT". Below "TEMPO," small red letters are partially obscured. To the right of the man, large white text reads: "POLITIK DUA YUDHOYONO". Below this, smaller white text states: "GAGAL BERSEKUTU DENGAN JOKOWI, PARTAI DEMOKRAT MELEMPAR SAUH KE KUBU PRABOWO. MENYIAPKAN AGUS HARIMURTI MENGHADAPI PEMILU PRESIDEN 2024?". 

In the bottom-left corner, white text includes: "30 JULI- 5 AGUSTUS 2018", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273". A barcode with numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00023" is below this text. The image is framed by a thick red border.
